card.line: Uz was a region, probably east or southeast of Palestine, where Job lived. It is named in Jeremiah and Lamentations alongside other nations that would face judgment.

moments.title: Job lives in Uz
moments.text: A man named Job lived in the land of Uz. He was blameless and upright, feared God, and was the greatest man of all the people of the East.

moments.title: Kings of Uz and the cup
moments.text: Jeremiah lists the kings of Uz among the nations who must drink the cup of the LORD's judgment.

moments.title: Edom in Uz warned
moments.text: Daughter of Edom, who lived in the land of Uz, was told to rejoice for now. The cup would pass to her too, and God would expose her sins.
